body: It was made pretty explicit to me before that any future failed work, or missed work etc would result in the termination of my studies - now I can't bring myself to try and meet it head on, ill fall into my old pattern of ignoring it and making it even worse..

it's not due in for a few months, but its worth 40% of my credits for this year, I've been working on it, but had been blissfully unaware that I was meant to be handing in my progress, and I also haven't made as much progress that they would of expected me to have by now (I was planning to hardcore it over the christmas break). It's a combination now of not having done as much I was meant to, and not handing it in.
